pages.description: Original 1901 Palestine map illustrating the Gospel by Matthew, immediately before the first printed Matthew Scripture page. Full original scan page retained.
pages.evidence_method: Visually inspected original complete 1901 scan; front-of-book map directly labels the Gospel by Matthew.
